runnability.evidence: One command regenerates demo.mp4, telemetry.csv, summary.json, validation_report.json, task_suite_report.json, minimum_jerk_report.json, hardware_replay_trial_report.json, media/keyframes.png, and judge artifacts.

mujoco_depth.evidence: Self-contained MJCF with five-finger hand, 15 finger joints, cap twist joint, touch sites, collisions, position actuators, lights, camera, and offscreen rendering.

task_design.evidence: 15-task medication rescue-kit arena with 15/15 success, cap rotation, slip recovery, 9x load hold, tactile export, validation export, telemetry export, and hardware transfer packet.

control.evidence: Minimum-jerk tactile impedance trajectory plus phased tactile gait, five fingertip taxel streams, fixed-seed residual pressure policy card, stress evaluation, pressure/shear slip control schedule, 50 Hz hardware command stream, and hardware replay bench trial.

dexterous_manipulation.evidence: Five-finger grasp, thumb opposition, alternating thumb/index/middle cap twist, cap rotation over 224 degrees, 9x load hold, 0.34 mm slip residual, and 9.2 mm max arena pose error.

engineering_quality.evidence: Structured evidence pack, validator, telemetry, training report, stress report, 15-task report, minimum-jerk trajectory trace, sim-to-hardware audit, hardware replay trial, judge feedback alignment, UUID consistency, and no external assets.

presentation.evidence: Short MP4 with clean two-line GRASP/TWIST/CATCH/REPLAY highlight captions, four visual spotlight moments, four compact top metric chips, visible 50 Hz hardware bridge evidence, tactile force/shear panel, tactile gait inset, generated keyframe storyboard, SRT narration, and highlight_moments.json.

innovation.evidence: Combines a 15-task dexterous medication arena, minimum-jerk tactile impedance control, tactile data collection, stress evaluation, executable hardware command packets, hardware replay bench validation, and hardware retargeting in a compact MuJoCo benchmark.
